title: Add-On Testing on Specimens Already in the Laboratory — Laboratory Test Orders
content:
An add-on test is a test requested for an existing Laboratory Test Orders accession after collection and performed on the specimen already in the laboratory.

## Conditions of acceptance

An add-on request is accepted only when every condition below holds:

1. **Who asks.** The request comes from the ordering provider of the order or that provider's office. The order record shows the ordering provider (by NPI); that the caller is that provider or office is a fact the caller establishes. Consumer-initiated orders never accept add-on tests; the patient places a new consumer order instead.
2. **Order status.** The order status is *accessioned*, *testing hold*, *in testing* or *resulted*.
3. **Timing.** The request is received no later than the class's add-on window, in calendar days, after the collection date recorded on the order. The collection date is day 0, so the last eligible day is the collection date plus the add-on window, and a request received on that day is accepted.
4. **Count.** The number of add-on tests already on the order is below the class's maximum add-on tests per accession. An add-on later credited off the order no longer counts. A class whose add-on window is 0 accepts no add-ons.
5. **Menu.** The added test is in the test menu of the order's own service class. A test of another class needs a new order.

## Result

An accepted add-on posts one add-on line at the test's list price. A refused add-on posts nothing, and the provider must send a new requisition, which needs a new collection.

## Boundary cases (hypothetical class with a 3-day window and a 4-test maximum, collection on 10 March)

| Request received | Add-ons already on the order | Status | Outcome |
|---|---|---|---|
| 13 March | 2 | in testing | Accepted (day 3 is the last eligible day) |
| 14 March | 0 | resulted | Refused (day 4 is past the window) |
| 12 March | 4 | accessioned | Refused (the count has reached the maximum) |
| 11 March | 1 | received | Refused (no specimen accessioned yet) |

## Points of judgement

- **Can the patient request the add-on for the provider?** No. Acceptance requires the ordering provider or that provider's office.
- **Does a resulted order still take add-ons?** Yes, if the request is within the window and under the count.
